body:
The unmatched-ingredient campaign needs guarded source application and canonical publication for an explicitly reviewed owner plan. These operators bind published proposals, source cases, acceptance, executed producer bytes and complete inventories, while preserving native receipt history and recovery evidence.

Depends on #1158 at `e000d66dd26ab053e9b17ce7bf8d3c873c3dde99`. Final code head: `7d6d44ea132e04709f81ebd9e1577643745110ad` (ordinary commit and nonforce push verified). Full QC and test suite: **RUNNING on this exact head**, with all20original plus10new actual native integration cases required. Final CI: **PENDING**. Independent #1259 review is sealed as **PRIVATE_TECHNICAL_PASS_WITH_VALIDATION_PENDING**, with no unresolved implementation finding; it does not replace committed-head validation. No maintained campaign source application or release-product publication has occurred. Scientific acceptance, actual plan acceptance and the dependent data PR remain separate. No merge is requested.

#1259 adds a closed version-2 publication contract for exactly four conditionally reviewed native suppression events. It consumes the original W07 review and all 119 declared input captures, an exact actual source/generation transition, a distinct passing independent review of all four transition targets, and explicit root selection. The six selected operations, two unchanged credited owners and genuine absent Corn Starch preimage remain explicit. Reviewer metadata alone does not authenticate independence; the assignment must also be independently established.

The sidecar becomes a third guarded destination alongside canonical mappings and policy. Publication reserves all three backups and success outputs before mutation, rechecks their bytes and all bound inputs at later boundaries, and clears success-shaped receipts after partial failure. It preserves the 34 historical sidecar rows, baseline, policy history and original owner attribution; only the four exact native event lines are appended. Only one existing canonical token is removed. Policy references the native mapping receipt, avoiding a circular dependency on the final publication log. Full receipt, owner-chain and position-map replay remains required; unrelated canonical lines and historical holds are preserved.

The original 27 receipt path/hash pairs remain mandatory. A genuinely completed pre-source suffix is accepted only through full contiguous native replay and the protected source checkpoint. Real tests exercise both the original 27-link prefix and a prior native transaction plus commit, followed by suppression publication through sequences 28 and 29. This technical suffix fixture is not approval of the separate #1258 ancillary curation. Congocidin, material identity, role, quantity and export holds remain intact.

The draft consumer's nonpassing-verdict defect was recorded before correction in [#1259](https://github.com/CultureBotAI/MediaIngredientMech/issues/1259#issuecomment-6721929601). Completed `blocked`/`needs_curation` reviews and failed required checks now refuse; valid `pass_with_limitations` retains the original scientific limits. The authentic-suffix refinement was likewise [recorded before implementation](https://github.com/CultureBotAI/MediaIngredientMech/issues/1259#issuecomment-6721966895).

Earlier #1256/#1257 corrections remain: source application validates captured literal index path/mode/stage/blob entries against accepted endpoints and detects changes within its observation boundaries; historical verification still permits later commits. Publication retains the live accepted-HEAD check through source-proof replay. Registry slots use full local object IDs, preserving distinct primary and subject-handle rows; a changed local identity is removal plus addition, without transferring provenance. The pinned historical receipt maker is unchanged. These are bounded observations, not a globally atomic OS transaction.

Other retained controls address #1174, #1194, #1195, #1197, #1198, #1200, #1214, #1251, #1252 and #1255. Explicit #741 demotion removes every old subject slot without choosing Angustmycin A/C, requires both paths to lack prior owner chains, and consumes the exact reviewed relocation tuple. No threshold, workflow, schema gate or validator pin is weakened.

Validation is reported as separate actual runs:

- The frozen #1259 combined run finished with **619 passed, 11 failed, zero skipped**. Ten failures were an old private-package fixture missing the new review script/schema; one new partial-target fixture was already rejected by the native validator before its expected-error block. Both were recorded before correction: [dependency-copy fixture](https://github.com/CultureBotAI/MediaIngredientMech/issues/1259#issuecomment-6722193253), [native-refusal fixture](https://github.com/CultureBotAI/MediaIngredientMech/issues/1259#issuecomment-6722200668).
- Only those fixtures changed: two real dependency paths were added to the old copy list, and the malformed completed-review case now asserts the actual native `ReviewError`. Existing assertion ASTs and parameter decorators remain unchanged. The **13 affected cases passed**, zero skipped; Ruff/Black passed. Publisher source remained `1108dd82061a03a4348de447834577a389f2692f15627877042b35f615fd1e24` throughout these fixture repairs. This is **not** a clean combined-run claim.
- Earlier source correction: 546 passed; registry-row correction: 196 passed, both zero skips, with separate independent controls. Their original failures and issue-first repairs remain preserved. Historical 16c full QC/tests passed; the 21061 full suite was interrupted after confirmed defects. Neither substitutes for final-head validation.
- The earlier external W08 review of 7d4 ran 518 checks, including 20 actual-native cases, and found the remaining source-index defect. Its session then hit a platform risk flag before final native review assembly. That incomplete negative packet is not successor approval.
- Real integrations use pinned Claw `76c1ebeea3fc7f80bf1abe044688f298f390cfac`, immutable historical receipts, authentic original scientific captures, and explicitly synthetic mechanical activation/transition reviews. Stored-label fallback and unavailable optional CI inputs are disclosed; CI alone must not be described as executing these external integrations.

The distinct independent review binds product `1108dd82`, both corrected test files and the original real integrations; its handoff is `bcbbe5d25157f0c7bf913560bfa53df243564b6631a6a93313351ce2e095feb2`. Committed-head QC/suite are running with the independently reviewed runner and explicit external input inventories. The external W07 final-head review is in progress. Actual campaign acceptance remains pending.

The final author package preserves its original failed run, corrected-case receipts, prior drafts and native 27/28-prefix witnesses. Its portable manifest is `dbbb96b81b3d6f1d48a6d7811888f002bb521429d1d398142f53754db6c51093`; the four-file patch is `4ac02fc1e9028ace1f71f6830b088a65ca922b3d3b35f51cfb620726706824c2`. The outer handoff's stale relative locators were recorded under [#1254](https://github.com/CultureBotAI/MediaIngredientMech/issues/1254#issuecomment-6722242457); immutable `LOCATOR-ADDENDUM-v1.json` (`7d32e7e25b628c948211dee91cd30c3b8faa2471f49735aed2bfb4d97f409d3d`) names the actual `portable-final/MANIFEST.json` and patch without rewriting evidence.

The existing 1,077 copied evidence files/descriptors remain uncommitted under `reports/unmatched_campaign_operators_1174_20261108/`. Final archive additions, whole-diff review and ordinary archive commit remain pending. Historical review identities and limitations remain intact; evidence packaging does not confer scientific or application approval.
